findings.title: Over-provisioned EC2 instances
findings.detail: m5.2xlarge is larger than its workload needs. Compute Optimizer recommends m5.large.
findings.action: Test on m5.large, then change the instance type during a maintenance window.

findings.title: Idle NAT gateways
findings.detail: No traffic in the last 14 days. NAT gateways bill by the hour whether or not anything uses them.
findings.action: Delete it and remove the route that points to it. Release its Elastic IP afterwards.

findings.title: Old snapshots of deleted volumes
findings.detail: Snapshot of a 500 GiB volume that no longer exists, 412 days old, not used by any of your AMIs. Snapshots are incremental, so the real cost is this amount or less.
findings.action: Confirm nobody needs it for recovery or compliance, then delete it (or move it to the snapshot archive tier).

findings.title: Instances stopped for 30+ days
findings.detail: c5.4xlarge stopped for 122 days. Its 2 attached volume(s), 300 GiB in total, are still billed.
findings.action: If it's not coming back, create an AMI (or snapshots) and terminate it.

findings.title: gp2 volumes that should be gp3
findings.detail: 1000 GiB gp2 volume. gp3 is about 20% cheaper per GB with the same or better baseline performance.
findings.action: Modify the volume type to gp3 (online, no downtime). Match IOPS if the volume is larger than 1 TiB.

findings.title: Abandoned S3 multipart uploads
findings.detail: 37 upload(s) started over 7 days ago and never finished, about 842.0 GB. They don't show in the console but are billed.
findings.action: Add a lifecycle rule: abort incomplete multipart uploads after 7 days.

findings.title: Log groups that never expire
findings.detail: 612.4 GB stored with retention set to 'never expire', so the bill grows every month.
findings.action: Set a retention period (30-90 days is typical; longer if compliance requires it). Saving is up to this amount.

findings.title: Idle load balancers
findings.detail: Classic load balancer with no registered instances.
findings.action: Delete it if no DNS record points at it.

findings.title: Idle load balancers

findings.action: Delete it if no DNS record or service points at it.
